messages:
marta: FYI I'm going to land the audit-event sampling layer + a small schema tweak for KMS actions today. Need eyes on customer-facing validation text and SDK examples before I ship. RFC here: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/audit-sampling

oliver: quick clarification — does sampling change event IDs or the envelope shape? customers will need guarantees for SIEM mapping.

marta: sampling only affects delivery frequency for high-volume events (e.g., tokenized streaming heartbeats). We will keep event_id and trace_id unchanged; envelope stays the same. Only add a sample_rate integer on the meta when events are sampled.

samir: can we use a backward-compatible key like `sampling_rate` instead of `sample_rate`? a few customers relied on exact key names in their parsers.

marta: good point. proposal: add `sampling_rate` and keep `sample_rate` as alias for a release cycle (write both). In the changelog we'll mark `sample_rate` deprecated for one quarter before removing.

elaine: customer comms draft: "We've added optional sampling metadata to certain high-volume audit events to reduce noise and cost for hosted logging. This does not modify event identifiers or change security semantics. If you ingest events into SIEM, make sure your parsing rules look for `sampling_rate` (or the legacy `sample_rate` alias) to compute total event counts." Thoughts?

marta: wording looks good. add a short example for SDKs. I put a sample payload below — please sanity-check:

```json
{
  "event_id": "evt_01F3X2...",
  "actor": "user:alice@example.com",
  "action": "kms.decrypt",
  "timestamp": "2025-06-01T18:22:03Z",
  "meta": {
    "region": "us-west-2",
    "sampling_rate": 100,
    "kms_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:..."
  }
}
```

oliver: sample looks good. For customers that validate schemas strictly, we should publish a machine-readable JSON Schema with versioning (v1.5?) and show an example of how to count effective events: `effective_count = 1 * sampling_rate` when sampling_rate > 1.

samir: also add an integration test that replays sampled events and asserts downstream counters match expected aggregated totals. CI can run it against the sample harness.

ci-bot: test/audit-sampling-harness passed (5m 12s) :white_check_mark:

security-ops: on vuln/triage side — any chance sampling could mask audit gaps for small windows? we need a playbook check in incident runbooks to verify full-fidelity logging for forensic windows.

marta: agreed. plan is to never sample security-critical events (privileged role grants, key rotations, auth failures). Sampling whitelist will be explicit. We'll add a post-incident checklist step: toggle sampling off for affected shards and replay full logs if available.

elaine: for customer-facing docs: include a short FAQ Q/A "Will sampling hide security events?" with a clear yes/no and the list of non-sampled event types. Also include instructions to toggle sampling in Dedicated/Private via the config flag `audit.sampling.enabled` per pool.

samir: about KMS fields — we're adding `kms_key_id` and `kms_action` to meta for clarity. `kms_action` values: encrypt, decrypt, rewrap, sign, verify. Keep them lowercase to avoid parser issues.

marta: agreed. will land the patch that writes both `sampling_rate` and `sample_rate` (same numeric value) and adds `kms_action`. I'll draft the changelog entry and customer announcement after the merge.

elaine: can you include a sample Splunk/ELK ingest rule snippet and a Marshaler change for our Java SDK? customers will ask for quick copy/paste.

marta: yes — adding an example ELK grok + Java snippet. ping me for final review. once merged I'll post a brief announcement to #announcements and email enterprise customers with dedicated rollouts. :mailbox_with_mail:
